Official Cinematic Desert Labrinth XDB Remix page: https://cinematiclabel.bandcamp.com/track/desert-labrinth-xdb-remix

exclusions: Every lead and candidate from earlier immutable requests was excluded, including the 2026-08-10 Mindworks, Flash, Drifting and Setmode request.
All current ledger identities, durable rejected entries, frozen Session 4 material and untriggered PARKED revisit entries were excluded.

The current-release lane returned no lead because its strongest tracks lacked either exact BPM, exact-track behavioural evidence, or a distinct non-frozen placement; no weak lead was padded into the request.

The overlooked-catalogue lane returned no lead because the strongest older tracks had unresolved exact BPM or identity and descriptions emphasizing manic melody, dramatic pads, hard-tool weight or drive; no weak lead was padded.

Adjacent alternatives were excluded when their legal placements duplicated existing groove-development, re-entry, release or threshold stages, or when source language introduced unresolved melody or pressure risk without a distinct role.
No proposed placement enters Iruka → Percussion Work → Interlynx, splits Deep Under → Wurk, or touches Interlynx → Minimum → Eclipse → Haidou → Calipso.
